description: Wet biomass to hopper (same as Aspen stream 1; not a separate Aspen stream)
Aspen 2: dried biomass plus the evaporated moisture (DRYER to DECOMP)
Aspen 14 + A: char carbon plus ash (SEP to MIXER)
Aspen AIRBLOWN: oxidant 45:55 O2:CO2 by mass
Aspen S1: raw syngas leaving the reduction zone (RED to B10)
Aspen S9: syngas after oxidant pre-heater (B10 to B1)
Aspen ASH: ash from hot cyclone B1
Aspen S2: de-ashed syngas (B1 to B2)
Aspen S4: cooled syngas (B2 to B5)
Aspen WAT: condensed water from knock-out B5
Aspen SYNGAS: dry syngas to engine air mixer B4
Aspen S8: engine exhaust (ENGINE to B16)
Aspen S15: exhaust to stack after heat recovery
Cooling water supply to syngas cooler - assumed (Aspen gives duty only)
